channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Europe, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Europe, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Braunschweig Projects 2027/28: Artistic Fellowships at HBK Braunschweig (Fine Arts and Sound Art)
item.description: Braunschweig University of Art (HBK Braunschweig), on behalf of the State of Lower Saxony · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Stipend of EUR 1,600 per month for 12 months, plus a rent-free one-person studio apartment in Braunschweig (fellows pay EUR 250 per month towards incidental living costs) and an allowance for project and travel costs. 7 fellowships: 5 in fine arts and 2 in sound art. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowship - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Columbia Institute for Ideas and Imagination: Paris Fellowship 2027-28
    https://ideasimagination.columbia.edu/apply/applying-for-a-fellowship/
    Columbia University Institute for Ideas and Imagination · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 75,000 stipend, plus housing at Reid Hall in Paris and office and research support, September 2027 to May 2028. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowship - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Stiftung Künstler*dorf Schöppingen: Residency Fellowship 2027 Open Call
    https://stiftung-kuenstlerdorf.de/en/application_process
    Stiftung Künstler*dorf Schöppingen · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Stipend of EUR 1,500 per month, minus roughly EUR 100-200 for rent and operating expenses. For collectives, EUR 1,000 per person up to a maximum of EUR 3,000 per month, minus rent and operating costs. Travel, insurance and material costs are covered only in exceptional cases, on request.
